All Classes and Interfaces

Classes
Class
Description
AleaCommand
Implements the alea test command for forcing a transporter room destination.
AssetManager
Downloads game assets from the ESIEE web server and stores them locally.
Attack
Represents a Pokemon attack with a name, base damage, and hit precision.
BackCommand
Implements the back command, moving the player to the previous room when possible.
BattleCommand
Starts a trainer battle, or lists available trainers when no trainer name is provided.
BattleManager
Manages battle state and turn processing.
CashinCommand
Implements the cashin command, converting selected quest items into money.
Command
Base type for all executable player commands.
CommandWords
Maintains the fixed vocabulary of primary commands understood by the game.
DropCommand
Implements the drop command, moving an item from the inventory to the current room.
Game
Application entry point for the Zuul-style Pokémon adventure game.
GameEngine
Central coordinator for game state, room navigation, and command handling.
GoCommand
Implements the go command for room navigation and transporter movement.
HelpCommand
Implements the help command, printing the game goal and command list.
InventoryCommand
Implements the inventory command, printing the player's current items.
Item
Describes a collectible or scenery object with a textual blurb and an arbitrary weight or price value surfaced to the player.
ItemList
Stores a private collection of items keyed by name.
LoadCommand
Implements the load command, restoring game state from a save file.
LoadingScreen
A splash screen displayed while the AssetManager downloads missing game assets from the remote server.
LookCommand
Implements the look command, reprinting the current room description.
MovingTrainer
A trainer that can randomly move between connected rooms while the player explores.
MusicPlayer
Plays an MP3 file in a loop on a background thread.
NameCommand
Implements the name command, changing the player's display name.
Parser
Converts raw user input into executable command objects.
Player
Stores the state that belongs to the player: identity, current position, history, and a personal item list.
Pokemon
Stores a Pokemon's combat name, hit points, and available moves.
QuitCommand
Implements the quit command, ending the game when the syntax is valid.
Room
Models one location in the game world: narrative text, image, exits to other rooms, and a keyed collection of Items the player can examine.
SaveCommand
Implements the save command, writing the current game state to a save file.
TakeCommand
Implements the take command, buying or collecting an item from the current room.
TestCommand
Implements the test command, replaying commands from a text resource.
Trainer
Represents a trainer who can appear in a room and battle the player.
TrainerList
Stores a private collection of trainers keyed by name.
TransporterRoom
Special room that teleports the player to one of several target rooms.
UserInterface
Swing-based graphical shell for the text adventure: log area, text field, directional shortcut buttons, and an optional room image.
